title: Noble Gases
text: Noble gases (helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon, and radon) occupy group 18 of the periodic table. They have a full outer electron shell, making them chemically inert under most conditions -- they rarely react with other elements. This stability makes them useful for applications requiring non-reactive environments, such as filling light bulbs and balloons (helium), neon signage, and welding (argon shielding gas).
